name: Lifeguard Training and Summer Jobs
org: City of Orlando Families, Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take a city run Red Cross lifeguard class, then apply for a summer job guarding a city pool. Hiring also covers a few year round pools.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 or older. You need a reliable ride and must pass background and drug screens. You must be free to work the whole summer. You must pass a swim test (200 yards, tread water 2 minutes, get a 10 pound brick).
duration: Certification classes over several days (January to May); then the summer season
deadline_text: Certification classes listed on the page ran January to May. The page does not state a year. Check the page for the next set of classes.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a certification class, take the swim test on day one, finish all days, then fill out the summer job application at the end of class. HR then sets up a background check and drug screening (can take up to 3 weeks).
notes: Bring a government ID and Social Security card to class, per the page. Call 407-246-4090. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed.
